en: Proverbs 28

p.src: 1  The wicked flee when no one pursues; but the righteous are as bold as a lion.

en: The wicked flee when no one pursues; but the righteous are as bold as a lion.
u.src: 1  The wicked flee when no one pursues; but the righteous are as bold as a lion.

p.src: 2  In rebellion, a land has many rulers, but order is maintained by a man of understanding and knowledge.

en: In rebellion, a land has many rulers, but order is maintained by a man of understanding and knowledge.
u.src: 2  In rebellion, a land has many rulers, but order is maintained by a man of understanding and knowledge.

p.src: 3  A needy man who oppresses the poor is like a driving rain which leaves no crops.

en: A needy man who oppresses the poor is like a driving rain which leaves no crops.
u.src: 3  A needy man who oppresses the poor is like a driving rain which leaves no crops.

p.src: 4  Those who forsake the law praise the wicked; but those who keep the law contend with them.

en: Those who forsake the law praise the wicked; but those who keep the law contend with them.
u.src: 4  Those who forsake the law praise the wicked; but those who keep the law contend with them.

p.src: 5  Evil men don’t understand justice; but those who seek the LORD understand it fully.

en: Evil men don’t understand justice; but those who seek the LORD understand it fully.
u.src: 5  Evil men don’t understand justice; but those who seek the LORD understand it fully.

p.src: 6  Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his ways, and he is rich.

en: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his ways, and he is rich.
u.src: 6  Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his ways, and he is rich.

p.src: 7  Whoever keeps the law is a wise son; but he who is a companion of gluttons shames his father.

en: Whoever keeps the law is a wise son; but he who is a companion of gluttons shames his father.
u.src: 7  Whoever keeps the law is a wise son; but he who is a companion of gluttons shames his father.

p.src: 8  He who increases his wealth by excessive interest gathers it for one who has pity on the poor.

en: He who increases his wealth by excessive interest gathers it for one who has pity on the poor.
u.src: 8  He who increases his wealth by excessive interest gathers it for one who has pity on the poor.

p.src: 9  He who turns away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer is an abomination.

en: He who turns away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer is an abomination.
u.src: 9  He who turns away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer is an abomination.

p.src: 10  Whoever causes the upright to go astray in an evil way, he will fall into his own trap; but the blameless will inherit good.

en: Whoever causes the upright to go astray in an evil way, he will fall into his own trap; but the blameless will inherit good.
u.src: 10  Whoever causes the upright to go astray in an evil way, he will fall into his own trap; but the blameless will inherit good.

p.src: 11  The rich man is wise in his own eyes; but the poor who has understanding sees through him.

en: The rich man is wise in his own eyes; but the poor who has understanding sees through him.
u.src: 11  The rich man is wise in his own eyes; but the poor who has understanding sees through him.

p.src: 12  When the righteous triumph, there is great glory; but when the wicked rise, men hide themselves.

en: When the righteous triumph, there is great glory; but when the wicked rise, men hide themselves.
u.src: 12  When the righteous triumph, there is great glory; but when the wicked rise, men hide themselves.

p.src: 13  He who conceals his sins doesn’t prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.

en: He who conceals his sins doesn’t prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.
u.src: 13  He who conceals his sins doesn’t prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.

p.src: 14  Blessed is the man who always fears; but one who hardens his heart falls into trouble.

en: Blessed is the man who always fears; but one who hardens his heart falls into trouble.
u.src: 14  Blessed is the man who always fears; but one who hardens his heart falls into trouble.

p.src: 15  As a roaring lion or a charging bear, so is a wicked ruler over helpless people.

en: As a roaring lion or a charging bear, so is a wicked ruler over helpless people.
u.src: 15  As a roaring lion or a charging bear, so is a wicked ruler over helpless people.

p.src: 16  A tyrannical ruler lacks judgment. One who hates ill-gotten gain will have long days.

en: A tyrannical ruler lacks judgment. One who hates ill-gotten gain will have long days.
u.src: 16  A tyrannical ruler lacks judgment. One who hates ill-gotten gain will have long days.

p.src: 17  A man who is tormented by blood guilt will be a fugitive until death. No one will support him.

en: A man who is tormented by blood guilt will be a fugitive until death. No one will support him.
u.src: 17  A man who is tormented by blood guilt will be a fugitive until death. No one will support him.

p.src: 18  Whoever walks blamelessly is kept safe; but one with perverse ways will fall suddenly.

en: Whoever walks blamelessly is kept safe; but one with perverse ways will fall suddenly.
u.src: 18  Whoever walks blamelessly is kept safe; but one with perverse ways will fall suddenly.

p.src: 19  One who works his land will have an abundance of food; but one who chases fantasies will have his fill of poverty.

en: One who works his land will have an abundance of food; but one who chases fantasies will have his fill of poverty.
u.src: 19  One who works his land will have an abundance of food; but one who chases fantasies will have his fill of poverty.

p.src: 20  A faithful man is rich with blessings; but one who is eager to be rich will not go unpunished.

en: A faithful man is rich with blessings; but one who is eager to be rich will not go unpunished.
u.src: 20  A faithful man is rich with blessings; but one who is eager to be rich will not go unpunished.

p.src: 21  To show partiality is not good, yet a man will do wrong for a piece of bread.

en: To show partiality is not good, yet a man will do wrong for a piece of bread.
u.src: 21  To show partiality is not good, yet a man will do wrong for a piece of bread.

p.src: 22  A stingy man hurries after riches, and doesn’t know that poverty waits for him.

en: A stingy man hurries after riches, and doesn’t know that poverty waits for him.
u.src: 22  A stingy man hurries after riches, and doesn’t know that poverty waits for him.

p.src: 23  One who rebukes a man will afterward find more favor than one who flatters with the tongue.

en: One who rebukes a man will afterward find more favor than one who flatters with the tongue.
u.src: 23  One who rebukes a man will afterward find more favor than one who flatters with the tongue.

p.src: 24  Whoever robs his father or his mother and says, “It’s not wrong,” is a partner with a destroyer.

en: Whoever robs his father or his mother and says, “It’s not wrong,” is a partner with a destroyer.
u.src: 24  Whoever robs his father or his mother and says, “It’s not wrong,” is a partner with a destroyer.

p.src: 25  One who is greedy stirs up strife; but one who trusts in the LORD will prosper.

en: One who is greedy stirs up strife; but one who trusts in the LORD will prosper.
u.src: 25  One who is greedy stirs up strife; but one who trusts in the LORD will prosper.

p.src: 26  One who trusts in himself is a fool; but one who walks in wisdom is kept safe.

en: One who trusts in himself is a fool; but one who walks in wisdom is kept safe.
u.src: 26  One who trusts in himself is a fool; but one who walks in wisdom is kept safe.

p.src: 27  One who gives to the poor has no lack; but one who closes his eyes will have many curses.

en: One who gives to the poor has no lack; but one who closes his eyes will have many curses.
u.src: 27  One who gives to the poor has no lack; but one who closes his eyes will have many curses.

p.src: 28  When the wicked rise, men hide themselves; but when they perish, the righteous thrive.

en: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves; but when they perish, the righteous thrive.
u.src: 28  When the wicked rise, men hide themselves; but when they perish, the righteous thrive.
